# KaTeX 0.16.22

Local math renderer for the Model Atlas formula journeys and architecture details.
Copied from the project's installed `upstream/transformer-explainer/node_modules/katex` package, version 0.16.22. `katex.js` is that package's unmodified `dist/katex.mjs`, renamed to `.js` for static-server MIME compatibility. CSS and fonts are copied unchanged from `dist`.

- Software: [MIT license](LICENSE).
- Fonts: [copyright, reserved font names and SIL Open Font License 1.1](fonts/OFL.txt), preserved from the distributed font metadata inventory.
- Official API reference: https://katex.org/docs/api.html

The lesson pages load the JavaScript, CSS and fonts from this directory; no math CDN or npm installation is needed to view them.
